title: Pittsfield Gym Says the January Rush Isn't What It Used to Be

facts.fact: The Whoopee radio article about a Pittsfield gym's January rush was published on January 5, 2026.
A Planet Fitness front-desk employee named Gary told the reporter that new sign-ups were about a quarter of the prior year's number.
facts.unit: share of last year's new sign-ups
facts.quote: "I'd say a quarter of what the number was last year," Gary told me.

facts.fact: The article reports that Planet Fitness in Pittsfield has a $15-a-month membership.
facts.quote: With its $15-a-month membership and judgment-free zone branding, Planet has solidified its spot as the city's fitness hub.

facts.fact: Per the article, most gym sign-ups now happen online, so new member activity is harder to gauge until Planet Fitness's monthly reports come out at the end of January.
facts.quote: Most sign-ups now happen online, making it harder to gauge new member activity until the monthly reports come in at the end of January.

facts.fact: The article states that Retro Fitness, a Pittsfield gym, closed its doors a few years before January 2026.
facts.quote: especially after Retro Fitness closed its doors a few years ago.
